items.source: Unregisters the specified NotificationListener.
items.translation: 注销指定的NotificationListener。

items.source: Set the MBeanServerConnection used to connect to the MBean which all invocations are routed to.
items.translation: 设置用于连接到所有调用都路由到的 MBean 的 `MBeanServerConnection`。

items.source: Set the service URL of the remote MBeanServer.
items.translation: 设置远程MBeanServer的服务 URL。

items.source: Logger available to subclasses.
items.translation: 可供子类使用的 Logger。

items.source: Specify the environment for the JMX connector.
items.translation: 指定 JMX 连接器的环境。

items.source: Default is none. If specified, this will result in an attempt being made to locate the attendant MBeanServer, unless the "serviceUrl" property has been set.
items.translation: 默认值为无。如果指定了该值，将尝试查找相关的 MBeanServer，除非已设置 `"serviceUrl"` 属性。

items.source: Useful for specifying entries directly, for example via environment[myKey]. This is particularly useful for adding or overriding entries in child bean definitions.
items.translation: 适用于直接指定条目，例如通过 `environment[myKey]`。这对于在子 Bean 定义中添加或覆盖条目特别有用。

items.source: Specifying the empty String indicates the platform MBeanServer.
items.translation: 指定空字符串表示平台 MBeanServer。

items.source: Ensures that an MBeanServerConnection is configured and attempts to detect a local connection if one is not supplied.
items.translation: 确保已配置 `MBeanServerConnection`，并且如果未提供本地连接，则尝试检测本地连接。

items.source:
This method allows the bean instance to perform validation of its overall
configuration and final initialization when all bean properties have been set.
items.translation: 此方法允许 Bean 实例在其所有属性设置完成后，执行其整体配置验证和最终初始化。

items.source: Registrar object that associates a specific NotificationListener with one or more MBeans in an MBeanServer (typically via a MBeanServerConnection).
items.translation: 注册对象，它将特定的 NotificationListener 与 MBeanServer 中的一个或多个 MBean 关联起来（通常通过 MBeanServerConnection）。

items.source: Invoked by the containing BeanFactory after it has set all bean properties and satisfied BeanFactoryAware, ApplicationContextAware etc.
items.translation: 由包含的BeanFactory在设置所有 bean 属性并满足BeanFactoryAware、ApplicationContextAware等接口后调用。

items.source: Description copied from interface: InitializingBean
items.translation: 描述从接口复制：InitializingBean

items.source: Allow Map access to the environment to be set for the connector, with the option to add or override specific entries.
items.translation: 允许为连接器设置对环境的 `Map` 访问权限，并可选择添加或覆盖特定条目。

items.source: Registers the specified NotificationListener.
items.translation: 注册指定的NotificationListener。

items.source: Set the agent id of the MBeanServer to locate.
items.translation: 将要定位的 MBeanServer 的代理 ID 设置为。

items.source: afterPropertiesSet in interface InitializingBean
items.translation: `afterPropertiesSet` 接口中的 `InitializingBean`

items.source: destroy in interface DisposableBean
items.translation: `destroy` 在接口 `DisposableBean` 中

items.translation: Jürgen Hoeller
